clips.title: The story
paras: At Whelgar's Excavation Site, Prospector Whelgar's search for titan relics has stalled. Vicious raptors overran the dig, and he seeks hardy adventurers to recover ancient artifacts.

Prospector Whelgar leads a dwarven dig in the Wetlands. His camp, Whelgar's Excavation Site, lies east of Menethil Harbor, where he searches for the history of the dwarven race. Ancient stone relics once filled the valley, but territorial raptors drove his team into hiding. Whelgar refuses to leave his duty unfinished. He still hopes to recover valuable relics, including the Goaz Stone, before predators or rival scoundrels ruin the site.
